# StashDog

> StashDog is a home inventory app for cataloging, organizing, sharing, and finding belongings across homes, boxes, storage units, collections, and moves.

StashDog helps people create a searchable inventory of what they own. It is built for households, families, collectors, renters, homeowners, movers, landlords, contractors, event businesses, resellers, and people managing storage spaces.

Core capabilities include photo-based item capture, AI-assisted item recognition, natural language search, collections, tags, containers, QR code labels, role-based sharing, document attachments, reminders, activity history, and cloud sync across devices.

StashDog is not a warehouse inventory system. It is designed for personal and household organization, moving, insurance documentation, storage tracking, and everyday retrieval.

## Primary Use Cases

- Create a home inventory for insurance documentation.
- Track boxes and containers during a move.
- Find items stored in closets, garages, attics, storage units, bins, and boxes.
- Share household inventory records with family members or trusted collaborators.
- Manage collections, tools, event supplies, resale inventory, or landlord property records.
- Attach photos, documents, receipts, serial numbers, and notes to item records.

## Product Positioning

StashDog is best described as:

- A home inventory app.
- A moving inventory app.
- A searchable storage and box tracking app.
- A free inventory app for households.
- A Sortly alternative for home users.
- An AI-assisted personal inventory tool.

StashDog is positioned against spreadsheets and business inventory tools that are too manual, too expensive, or too warehouse-oriented for household use.

## Pricing Summary

StashDog offers a free plan and a Plus plan. See the canonical machine-readable pricing file at https://stashdog.io/pricing.md and the public pricing page at https://stashdog.io/pricing/.
